The '''Karka system''' was located in the [[Clacis sector/Legends|Clacis sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|meal]] known as [[karkan ribene]]s.<ref name="Specter">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[karkan ribene]]s|system=Karka [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Karka [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-4.<ref name="TEA" />
